certificate.caveat: When operated in approved mode. The module generates SSPs (e.g., keys) whose strengths are modified by available entropy.
certificate.description: The module is a VPN Client application. It provides secure communication over untrusted networks. To provide this security, the module implements IKEv2/IPsec. It can be configured over a local, web-based interface.
